description: This file provides assertion utilities for testing purposes, including custom assert and nassert functions, and a test function to run test cases while tracking success and failure counts.

methods.name: assert
methods.description: Checks if two values are equal using a custom comparison function, increments counters, and prints debug info on failure.

methods.name: nassert
methods.description: Checks if two values are not equal, similar to assert but for inequality.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Runs a test case, resets counters, executes callback, reports success count, and returns overall pass/fail status.
